children: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (KRX:000660) is accelerating global memory expansion—mass shipping 48GB HBM4 to Nvidia's Rubin, planning to double wafer capacity with a ₩1,100 trillion investment target, exploring US fabs with Solidigm/Intel talks, and building a Sogang pipeline amid 19% NAND share.
: SK hynix (000660) began mass shipping a 48GB, 16-layer HBM4 memory device to Nvidia’s Rubin AI platform in Q3 2026, per company report.
: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (000660) announced plans to roughly double its wafer capacity over the next five years and disclosed a long-term investment target of ₩1,100 trillion (US$797 billion).
: SK hynix (000660) subsidiary Solidigm is in talks to build a NAND flash plant in Upstate New York; discussions ongoing, no deal yet, U.S. site could complement Dalian facility.
: SK hynix (000660) is in exploratory talks with Intel on US memory-chip production, possibly leasing part of Intel’s Ohio site or a JV; company says no deal finalized. Shares rose 4.08%.
: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (000660) holds about a 19% share of the NAND flash market, per recent sector data amid CXMT and YMTC expansion in China.

: SK hynix (000660) and Sogang University launched a four-year semiconductor engineering program that offers a direct hiring pipeline and conditional job offers for students meeting academic criteria.
